hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southeastern Asia, bordering the Andaman Sea and the Bay of Bengal, between Bangladesh and Thailand || central lowlands ringed by steep, rugged highlands || strategic location near major Indian Ocean shipping lanes; the north-south flowing Irrawaddy River is the country's largest and most important commercial waterway || Resources: petroleum, timber, tin, antimony, zinc, copper, tungsten, lead, coal, marble, limestone, precious stones, natural gas, hydropower, arable land || Exports: garments, natural gas, dried legumes, rare-earth metal compounds, precious stones (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: central lowlands ringed by steep, rugged highlands || Southeastern Asia, bordering the Andaman Sea and the Bay of Bengal, between Bangladesh and Thailand

climate.excerpt: tropical monsoon; cloudy, rainy, hot, humid summers (southwest monsoon, June to September); less cloudy, scant rainfall, mild temperatures, lower humidity during winter (northeast monsoon, December to April) || destructive earthquakes and cyclones; flooding and landslides common during rainy season (June to September); periodic droughts

economy.excerpt: slowly recovering Southeast Asian economy; household incomes weaken domestic consumption; growing trade deficit; declining employment; high inflation and reduced currency power; agriculture sector remains most stable || Exports: garments, natural gas, dried legumes, rare-earth metal compounds, precious stones (2023) || Industries: agricultural processing; wood and wood products; copper, tin, tungsten, iron; cement, construction materials; pharmaceuticals; fertilizer; oil and natural gas; garments; jade and gems
